editor.resetConfirm: Reset the island to how it started? All your changes will be lost.
editor.hintIdle: Pick an item, then tap the grass to place it · tap anything on the island to edit it
editor.hintTool: Move the pointer to preview {item} (red means it can’t go there) · R rotate · F flip · +/- size · click to place
editor.hintSelected: Drag to move · or rotate, resize, put away with the buttons below
editor.notice_limit: You have added {max} items — put some away to add more
editor.notice_animalLimit: The island can host up to {max} extra animals
editor.notice_cantPlace: Can't place it here — try flatter grass (not the pond, stream or cliffs)
editor.save_error: Couldn't save — check your connection, the next change will retry
editor.grow_young: Growing — {n}/7 check-in days. Each day you check in, it grows a little.
editor.grow_grown: Fully grown ({n} check-in days) — neat and healthy.
editor.grow_overgrown: It's getting overgrown — tap Trim to tidy it up.
editor.hintPath: Tap points on the grass one after another to lay a path
editor.hintPathMore: Tap to extend the path · "Finish this path" to start a new one
editor.brushHelp: Turn the brush on, pick an item, then hold and sweep over the island to plant along your stroke
editor.hintBrush: Hold and sweep over the grass to scatter {item}
editor.notice_pathLimit: You have {max} paths — remove one to draw more
editor.notice_pathLong: This path is quite long — finish it and start a new one
editor.age_grown: Neat and tidy — it gets a little bushier each day you check in. You can still trim it for a lighter shape.
editor.age_overgrown: It's getting bushy ({n} days since trimming) — tap Trim to tidy it up.
editor.hintTrim: Tap a tree, bush or flower to trim it — bushy plants get tidied, neat ones get a lighter shape
editor.notice_notPlant: Shears only work on trees, bushes, flowers and grass
editor.notice_trimMin: This one's already trimmed as far as it goes
editor.hintErase: Tap anything on the island (plants, rocks, decor, animals, paths) to remove it · Undo if you slip
editor.clearAllConfirm: Clear the island? All trees, flowers, grass, rocks, decor, animals and paths will be put away — only the land, pond, stream and mountain remain for you to rebuild. You can Undo right after, or use "Reset" to get the original island back.
editor.hintToolTouch: Tap the grass to preview {item} · rotate, flip, resize, then tap "Place here"
